signal_evidence.services_demand: CPN annualized total payment volume approaching $10 billion as of May 7, up nearly 75% since last reporting period, driven by B2B cross-border flows.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: Adjusted operating expenses were $136 million, up 32% year-over-year as we continued to invest in our product, distribution and operating infrastructure to drive long-term growth.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: Revenue less distribution cost margin was 41.4%, up 1.5 percentage points year-over-year, driven by growth in USDC held on our platform and by the growth in other revenue.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: USDC is the most widely transacted and used dollar digital currency in the world... we believe this leadership position and the network effects that flow from it will continue to compound to Circle.
